name: nettertech-events
description: A clean, performant WordPress events plugin with ticketing, recurring events, and WooCommerce integration.

scripts.minify:js: terser assets/js/public-checkin.js -o assets/js/public-checkin.min.js && terser assets/js/public-checkin-scanner.js -o assets/js/public-checkin-scanner.min.js && terser assets/js/waitlist-frontend.js -o assets/js/waitlist-frontend.min.js
scripts.minify:css: cleancss -o assets/css/public-checkin.min.css assets/css/public-checkin.css && cleancss -o assets/css/waitlist-frontend.min.css assets/css/waitlist-frontend.css
scripts.minify: npm run minify:js && npm run minify:css
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:js:fix && npm run lint:css:fix
